attributes.description: Single-pane health view of every Supabase log stream. Starts with cross-service volume and a unified error signal, then drills into each service in turn: API Gateway, Edge Functions, PostgreSQL, connection pooling, PostgREST, Storage and Realtime. Error detection differs per service, so each section uses the signal that is actually reliable for that stream.

params.markdown:
## [Supabase OTel] Service logs overview

Health of every service in a Supabase project, one section per log stream:
- Cross-service log volume and a unified error signal
- PostgreSQL severities, SQLSTATEs and backend activity
- Connection pooler churn and connection errors
- PostgREST schema cache and connection state
- API Gateway traffic, status mix and backend attribution
- Edge Function invocation outcomes and execution time
- Storage request outcomes, latency and object lifecycle
- Realtime connection utilisation against its cap

Error detection is not uniform. Gateway errors come from HTTP status
(4xx is logged at WARN), Supavisor errors are logged at `info`, and
PostgREST/pgbouncer have no severity at all.

query.esql:
FROM logs-supabase.otel-*
| STATS total_records = COUNT(*)

FROM logs-supabase.otel-*
| STATS total_records = COUNT(*)

FROM logs-supabase.otel-*
| WHERE attributes.supabase.service == "edge_logs" AND attributes.http.response.status_code IS NOT NULL
| STATS gateway_requests = COUNT(*)

FROM logs-supabase.otel-*
| WHERE attributes.supabase.service == "edge_logs" AND attributes.http.response.status_code IS NOT NULL
| STATS gateway_requests = COUNT(*)

FROM logs-supabase.otel-*
| WHERE attributes.supabase.service == "edge_logs" AND attributes.http.response.status_code >= 500
| STATS server_errors = COUNT(*)

FROM logs-supabase.otel-*
| WHERE attributes.supabase.service == "edge_logs" AND attributes.http.response.status_code >= 500
| STATS server_errors = COUNT(*)

FROM logs-supabase.otel-*
| WHERE attributes.supabase.service == "edge_logs" AND attributes.http.response.status_code >= 400 AND attributes.http.response.status_code < 500
| STATS client_errors = COUNT(*)

FROM logs-supabase.otel-*
| WHERE attributes.supabase.service == "edge_logs" AND attributes.http.response.status_code >= 400 AND attributes.http.response.status_code < 500
| STATS client_errors = COUNT(*)

FROM logs-supabase.otel-*
| WHERE attributes.supabase.service == "postgres_logs" AND attributes.supabase.db.error_severity IN ("ERROR", "FATAL", "PANIC")
| STATS db_errors = COUNT(*)

FROM logs-supabase.otel-*
| WHERE attributes.supabase.service == "postgres_logs" AND attributes.supabase.db.error_severity IN ("ERROR", "FATAL", "PANIC")
| STATS db_errors = COUNT(*)

FROM logs-supabase.otel-*
| WHERE attributes.supabase.service == "edge_function_invocation_logs" AND attributes.http.response.status_code >= 500
| STATS function_failures = COUNT(*)

FROM logs-supabase.otel-*
| WHERE attributes.supabase.service == "edge_function_invocation_logs" AND attributes.http.response.status_code >= 500
| STATS function_failures = COUNT(*)

FROM logs-supabase.otel-*
| WHERE attributes.supabase.service IN ("supavisor", "supavisor_logs") AND attributes.code.function.name LIKE "*Error.terminate_with_error*"
| STATS pooler_errors = COUNT(*)

FROM logs-supabase.otel-*
| WHERE attributes.supabase.service IN ("supavisor", "supavisor_logs") AND attributes.code.function.name LIKE "*Error.terminate_with_error*"
| STATS pooler_errors = COUNT(*)

FROM logs-supabase.otel-*
| WHERE attributes.supabase.service == "storage_logs" AND attributes.http.request.method IS NOT NULL AND attributes.supabase.event.duration IS NOT NULL
| EVAL duration_ms = attributes.supabase.event.duration / 1000000
| STATS storage_p95_ms = PERCENTILE(duration_ms, 95.0)

FROM logs-supabase.otel-*
| WHERE attributes.supabase.service == "storage_logs" AND attributes.http.request.method IS NOT NULL AND attributes.supabase.event.duration IS NOT NULL
| EVAL duration_ms = attributes.supabase.event.duration / 1000000
| STATS storage_p95_ms = PERCENTILE(duration_ms, 95.0)

params.markdown:
## 1 · Cross-service health

Volume and a unified error signal across every stream. Start here, then drop into the section for whichever service looks wrong.

query.esql:
FROM logs-supabase.otel-*
| STATS records = COUNT(*) BY time_bucket = BUCKET(@timestamp, 20, ?_tstart, ?_tend), service = attributes.supabase.service
| SORT time_bucket ASC

FROM logs-supabase.otel-*
| STATS records = COUNT(*) BY time_bucket = BUCKET(@timestamp, 20, ?_tstart, ?_tend), service = attributes.supabase.service
| SORT time_bucket ASC

FROM logs-supabase.otel-*
| EVAL service = attributes.supabase.service
| EVAL is_error = CASE(service == "edge_logs" AND attributes.http.response.status_code >= 400, 1, service IN ("supavisor", "supavisor_logs") AND attributes.code.function.name LIKE "*Error.terminate_with_error*", 1, service == "postgres_logs" AND attributes.supabase.db.error_severity IN ("ERROR", "FATAL", "PANIC"), 1, attributes.http.response.status_code >= 400, 1, severity_number >= 17, 1, 0)
| STATS errors = SUM(is_error) BY time_bucket = BUCKET(@timestamp, 20, ?_tstart, ?_tend), service
| SORT time_bucket ASC

FROM logs-supabase.otel-*
| EVAL service = attributes.supabase.service
| EVAL is_error = CASE(service == "edge_logs" AND attributes.http.response.status_code >= 400, 1, service IN ("supavisor", "supavisor_logs") AND attributes.code.function.name LIKE "*Error.terminate_with_error*", 1, service == "postgres_logs" AND attributes.supabase.db.error_severity IN ("ERROR", "FATAL", "PANIC"), 1, attributes.http.response.status_code >= 400, 1, severity_number >= 17, 1, 0)
| STATS errors = SUM(is_error) BY time_bucket = BUCKET(@timestamp, 20, ?_tstart, ?_tend), service
| SORT time_bucket ASC

FROM logs-supabase.otel-*
| EVAL service = attributes.supabase.service
| EVAL is_error = CASE(service == "edge_logs" AND attributes.http.response.status_code >= 400, 1, service IN ("supavisor", "supavisor_logs") AND attributes.code.function.name LIKE "*Error.terminate_with_error*", 1, service == "postgres_logs" AND attributes.supabase.db.error_severity IN ("ERROR", "FATAL", "PANIC"), 1, attributes.http.response.status_code >= 400, 1, severity_number >= 17, 1, 0)
| STATS `Records` = COUNT(*), `Errors` = SUM(is_error) BY `Service` = service
| EVAL `Error rate` = TO_DOUBLE(`Errors`) / TO_DOUBLE(`Records`)
| SORT `Records` DESC
| LIMIT 20

FROM logs-supabase.otel-*
| EVAL service = attributes.supabase.service
| EVAL is_error = CASE(service == "edge_logs" AND attributes.http.response.status_code >= 400, 1, service IN ("supavisor", "supavisor_logs") AND attributes.code.function.name LIKE "*Error.terminate_with_error*", 1, service == "postgres_logs" AND attributes.supabase.db.error_severity IN ("ERROR", "FATAL", "PANIC"), 1, attributes.http.response.status_code >= 400, 1, severity_number >= 17, 1, 0)
| STATS `Records` = COUNT(*), `Errors` = SUM(is_error) BY `Service` = service
| EVAL `Error rate` = TO_DOUBLE(`Errors`) / TO_DOUBLE(`Records`)
| SORT `Records` DESC
| LIMIT 20

params.markdown:
## 2 · Database — `postgres_logs`

The richest error signal in the set, and the highest-priority one: everything else
degrades downstream of the database. `FATAL` and `PANIC` are always actionable.
SQLSTATE gives the precise failure — `53300` too many connections, `08006`/`08P01`
connection failures, `57014` cancelled query, `23505` unique violation.

query.esql:
FROM logs-supabase.otel-*
| WHERE attributes.supabase.service == "postgres_logs"
| STATS records = COUNT(*) BY time_bucket = BUCKET(@timestamp, 20, ?_tstart, ?_tend), severity = attributes.supabase.db.error_severity
| SORT time_bucket ASC

FROM logs-supabase.otel-*
| WHERE attributes.supabase.service == "postgres_logs"
| STATS records = COUNT(*) BY time_bucket = BUCKET(@timestamp, 20, ?_tstart, ?_tend), severity = attributes.supabase.db.error_severity
| SORT time_bucket ASC

FROM logs-supabase.otel-*
| WHERE attributes.supabase.service == "postgres_logs" AND attributes.db.response.status_code IS NOT NULL AND attributes.db.response.status_code != "00000"
| STATS occurrences = COUNT(*) BY sqlstate = attributes.db.response.status_code
| SORT occurrences DESC
| LIMIT 15

FROM logs-supabase.otel-*
| WHERE attributes.supabase.service == "postgres_logs" AND attributes.db.response.status_code IS NOT NULL AND attributes.db.response.status_code != "00000"
| STATS occurrences = COUNT(*) BY sqlstate = attributes.db.response.status_code
| SORT occurrences DESC
| LIMIT 15

FROM logs-supabase.otel-*
| WHERE attributes.supabase.service == "postgres_logs" AND attributes.supabase.db.backend_type IS NOT NULL
| STATS records = COUNT(*) BY time_bucket = BUCKET(@timestamp, 20, ?_tstart, ?_tend), backend_type = attributes.supabase.db.backend_type
| SORT time_bucket ASC

FROM logs-supabase.otel-*
| WHERE attributes.supabase.service == "postgres_logs" AND attributes.supabase.db.backend_type IS NOT NULL
| STATS records = COUNT(*) BY time_bucket = BUCKET(@timestamp, 20, ?_tstart, ?_tend), backend_type = attributes.supabase.db.backend_type
| SORT time_bucket ASC

FROM logs-supabase.otel-*
| WHERE attributes.supabase.service == "postgres_logs" AND attributes.db.operation.name IS NOT NULL
| STATS records = COUNT(*) BY operation = attributes.db.operation.name
| SORT records DESC
| LIMIT 10

FROM logs-supabase.otel-*
| WHERE attributes.supabase.service == "postgres_logs" AND attributes.db.operation.name IS NOT NULL
| STATS records = COUNT(*) BY operation = attributes.db.operation.name
| SORT records DESC
| LIMIT 10

FROM logs-supabase.otel-*
| WHERE attributes.supabase.service == "postgres_logs" AND attributes.supabase.db.error_severity IN ("WARNING", "ERROR", "FATAL", "PANIC")
| SORT @timestamp DESC
| EVAL `Time` = @timestamp, `Severity` = attributes.supabase.db.error_severity, `SQLSTATE` = attributes.db.response.status_code, `Database` = attributes.db.namespace, `Role` = attributes.user.name, `Client` = attributes.client.address, `Message` = body.text
| KEEP `Time`, `Severity`, `SQLSTATE`, `Database`, `Role`, `Client`, `Message`
| LIMIT 100

FROM logs-supabase.otel-*
| WHERE attributes.supabase.service == "postgres_logs" AND attributes.supabase.db.error_severity IN ("WARNING", "ERROR", "FATAL", "PANIC")
| SORT @timestamp DESC
| EVAL `Time` = @timestamp, `Severity` = attributes.supabase.db.error_severity, `SQLSTATE` = attributes.db.response.status_code, `Database` = attributes.db.namespace, `Role` = attributes.user.name, `Client` = attributes.client.address, `Message` = body.text
| KEEP `Time`, `Severity`, `SQLSTATE`, `Database`, `Role`, `Client`, `Message`
| LIMIT 100

params.markdown:
## 3 · Connection pooling — `supavisor` + `pgbouncer_logs`

Neither pooler exposes a pool-occupancy counter, so saturation is inferred from
behaviour: connection errors, and the balance between authentications and terminations.
**Supavisor logs its errors at `info` severity** — severity filtering finds nothing.
The structured signal is the emitting function name.

query.esql:
FROM logs-supabase.otel-*
| WHERE attributes.supabase.service IN ("supavisor", "supavisor_logs")
| EVAL event_type = CASE(attributes.code.function.name LIKE "*Error.terminate_with_error*", "Connection error", attributes.code.function.name LIKE "*handle_auth_success*", "Client authenticated", attributes.code.function.name LIKE "*ClientHandler.handle_event*", "Client lifecycle", attributes.code.function.name LIKE "*DbHandler*", "Backend handler", attributes.code.function.name LIKE "*Manager*", "Pool manager", attributes.code.function.name LIKE "*start_local_pool*", "Pool start", "Other")
| STATS records = COUNT(*) BY time_bucket = BUCKET(@timestamp, 20, ?_tstart, ?_tend), event_type
| SORT time_bucket ASC

FROM logs-supabase.otel-*
| WHERE attributes.supabase.service IN ("supavisor", "supavisor_logs")
| EVAL event_type = CASE(attributes.code.function.name LIKE "*Error.terminate_with_error*", "Connection error", attributes.code.function.name LIKE "*handle_auth_success*", "Client authenticated", attributes.code.function.name LIKE "*ClientHandler.handle_event*", "Client lifecycle", attributes.code.function.name LIKE "*DbHandler*", "Backend handler", attributes.code.function.name LIKE "*Manager*", "Pool manager", attributes.code.function.name LIKE "*start_local_pool*", "Pool start", "Other")
| STATS records = COUNT(*) BY time_bucket = BUCKET(@timestamp, 20, ?_tstart, ?_tend), event_type
| SORT time_bucket ASC

FROM logs-supabase.otel-*
| WHERE attributes.supabase.service IN ("supavisor", "supavisor_logs")
| EVAL is_auth = CASE(attributes.code.function.name LIKE "*handle_auth_success*", 1, 0), is_lifecycle = CASE(attributes.code.function.name LIKE "*ClientHandler.handle_event*", 1, 0), is_error = CASE(attributes.code.function.name LIKE "*Error.terminate_with_error*", 1, 0)
| STATS authenticated = SUM(is_auth), lifecycle = SUM(is_lifecycle), errors = SUM(is_error) BY time_bucket = BUCKET(@timestamp, 20, ?_tstart, ?_tend)
| SORT time_bucket ASC

FROM logs-supabase.otel-*
| WHERE attributes.supabase.service IN ("supavisor", "supavisor_logs")
| EVAL is_auth = CASE(attributes.code.function.name LIKE "*handle_auth_success*", 1, 0), is_lifecycle = CASE(attributes.code.function.name LIKE "*ClientHandler.handle_event*", 1, 0), is_error = CASE(attributes.code.function.name LIKE "*Error.terminate_with_error*", 1, 0)
| STATS authenticated = SUM(is_auth), lifecycle = SUM(is_lifecycle), errors = SUM(is_error) BY time_bucket = BUCKET(@timestamp, 20, ?_tstart, ?_tend)
| SORT time_bucket ASC

FROM logs-supabase.otel-*
| WHERE attributes.supabase.service == "pgbouncer_logs"
| EVAL event_type = CASE(body.text LIKE "*login attempt*", "Login attempt", body.text LIKE "*closing because*", "Connection closed", "Other")
| STATS records = COUNT(*) BY time_bucket = BUCKET(@timestamp, 20, ?_tstart, ?_tend), event_type
| SORT time_bucket ASC

FROM logs-supabase.otel-*
| WHERE attributes.supabase.service == "pgbouncer_logs"
| EVAL event_type = CASE(body.text LIKE "*login attempt*", "Login attempt", body.text LIKE "*closing because*", "Connection closed", "Other")
| STATS records = COUNT(*) BY time_bucket = BUCKET(@timestamp, 20, ?_tstart, ?_tend), event_type
| SORT time_bucket ASC

FROM logs-supabase.otel-*
| WHERE attributes.supabase.service IN ("supavisor", "supavisor_logs") AND attributes.code.function.name LIKE "*Error.terminate_with_error*"
| SORT @timestamp DESC
| EVAL `Time` = @timestamp, `Pooler` = attributes.supabase.pooler.type, `Database` = attributes.db.namespace, `User` = attributes.user.name, `Message` = body.text
| KEEP `Time`, `Pooler`, `Database`, `User`, `Message`
| LIMIT 100

FROM logs-supabase.otel-*
| WHERE attributes.supabase.service IN ("supavisor", "supavisor_logs") AND attributes.code.function.name LIKE "*Error.terminate_with_error*"
| SORT @timestamp DESC
| EVAL `Time` = @timestamp, `Pooler` = attributes.supabase.pooler.type, `Database` = attributes.db.namespace, `User` = attributes.user.name, `Message` = body.text
| KEEP `Time`, `Pooler`, `Database`, `User`, `Message`
| LIMIT 100

params.markdown:
## 4 · PostgREST — `postgrest_logs`

PostgREST logs schema cache and DB connection lifecycle, **not** individual API requests —
for REST traffic use the `/rest/v1/*` slice of the gateway section above. This stream has
no severity and no structured error field, so everything here is text-derived. A healthy
project is quiet; repeated rapid reloads mean schema or DB connection instability.

query.esql:
FROM logs-supabase.otel-*
| WHERE attributes.supabase.service == "postgrest_logs"
| EVAL event_type = CASE(body.text LIKE "*Schema cache loaded*", "Schema cache loaded", body.text LIKE "*Schema cache queried*", "Schema cache queried", body.text LIKE "*schema cache reload message*", "Schema reload requested", body.text LIKE "*Config reloaded*", "Config reloaded", body.text LIKE "*Successfully connected*", "Connected to PostgreSQL", "Other")
| STATS records = COUNT(*) BY time_bucket = BUCKET(@timestamp, 20, ?_tstart, ?_tend), event_type
| SORT time_bucket ASC

FROM logs-supabase.otel-*
| WHERE attributes.supabase.service == "postgrest_logs"
| EVAL event_type = CASE(body.text LIKE "*Schema cache loaded*", "Schema cache loaded", body.text LIKE "*Schema cache queried*", "Schema cache queried", body.text LIKE "*schema cache reload message*", "Schema reload requested", body.text LIKE "*Config reloaded*", "Config reloaded", body.text LIKE "*Successfully connected*", "Connected to PostgreSQL", "Other")
| STATS records = COUNT(*) BY time_bucket = BUCKET(@timestamp, 20, ?_tstart, ?_tend), event_type
| SORT time_bucket ASC

FROM logs-supabase.otel-*
| WHERE attributes.supabase.service == "postgrest_logs"
| SORT @timestamp DESC
| EVAL `Time` = @timestamp, `Identifier` = attributes.supabase.identifier, `Message` = body.text
| KEEP `Time`, `Identifier`, `Message`
| LIMIT 100

FROM logs-supabase.otel-*
| WHERE attributes.supabase.service == "postgrest_logs"
| SORT @timestamp DESC
| EVAL `Time` = @timestamp, `Identifier` = attributes.supabase.identifier, `Message` = body.text
| KEEP `Time`, `Identifier`, `Message`
| LIMIT 100

params.markdown:
## 5 · API Gateway — `edge_logs`

The front door: every request to the project passes through here first. There is no
queryable latency field on this stream, so volume and status-code shape are the proxy.
Status `101` is a WebSocket upgrade for Realtime and is a **success**.

query.esql:
FROM logs-supabase.otel-*
| WHERE attributes.supabase.service == "edge_logs" AND attributes.http.response.status_code IS NOT NULL
| STATS requests = COUNT(*) BY time_bucket = BUCKET(@timestamp, 20, ?_tstart, ?_tend), status = TO_STRING(attributes.http.response.status_code)
| SORT time_bucket ASC

FROM logs-supabase.otel-*
| WHERE attributes.supabase.service == "edge_logs" AND attributes.http.response.status_code IS NOT NULL
| STATS requests = COUNT(*) BY time_bucket = BUCKET(@timestamp, 20, ?_tstart, ?_tend), status = TO_STRING(attributes.http.response.status_code)
| SORT time_bucket ASC

FROM logs-supabase.otel-*
| WHERE attributes.supabase.service == "edge_logs" AND attributes.http.response.status_code IS NOT NULL
| EVAL outcome = CASE(attributes.http.response.status_code >= 500, "5xx server error", attributes.http.response.status_code >= 400, "4xx client error", "Success (1xx/2xx/3xx)")
| STATS requests = COUNT(*) BY time_bucket = BUCKET(@timestamp, 20, ?_tstart, ?_tend), outcome
| SORT time_bucket ASC

FROM logs-supabase.otel-*
| WHERE attributes.supabase.service == "edge_logs" AND attributes.http.response.status_code IS NOT NULL
| EVAL outcome = CASE(attributes.http.response.status_code >= 500, "5xx server error", attributes.http.response.status_code >= 400, "4xx client error", "Success (1xx/2xx/3xx)")
| STATS requests = COUNT(*) BY time_bucket = BUCKET(@timestamp, 20, ?_tstart, ?_tend), outcome
| SORT time_bucket ASC

FROM logs-supabase.otel-*
| WHERE attributes.supabase.service == "edge_logs" AND attributes.url.path IS NOT NULL
| EVAL backend = CASE(attributes.url.path LIKE "/rest/v1/*", "PostgREST (/rest)", attributes.url.path LIKE "/storage/v1/*", "Storage (/storage)", attributes.url.path LIKE "/realtime/v1/*", "Realtime (/realtime)", attributes.url.path LIKE "/functions/v1/*", "Edge Functions (/functions)", attributes.url.path LIKE "/auth/v1/*", "Auth (/auth)", attributes.url.path LIKE "/graphql/v1*", "GraphQL (/graphql)", "Other")
| STATS requests = COUNT(*) BY backend
| SORT requests DESC
| LIMIT 10

FROM logs-supabase.otel-*
| WHERE attributes.supabase.service == "edge_logs" AND attributes.url.path IS NOT NULL
| EVAL backend = CASE(attributes.url.path LIKE "/rest/v1/*", "PostgREST (/rest)", attributes.url.path LIKE "/storage/v1/*", "Storage (/storage)", attributes.url.path LIKE "/realtime/v1/*", "Realtime (/realtime)", attributes.url.path LIKE "/functions/v1/*", "Edge Functions (/functions)", attributes.url.path LIKE "/auth/v1/*", "Auth (/auth)", attributes.url.path LIKE "/graphql/v1*", "GraphQL (/graphql)", "Other")
| STATS requests = COUNT(*) BY backend
| SORT requests DESC
| LIMIT 10

FROM logs-supabase.otel-*
| WHERE attributes.supabase.service == "edge_logs" AND attributes.http.request.method IS NOT NULL
| STATS requests = COUNT(*) BY method = attributes.http.request.method
| SORT requests DESC
| LIMIT 10

FROM logs-supabase.otel-*
| WHERE attributes.supabase.service == "edge_logs" AND attributes.http.request.method IS NOT NULL
| STATS requests = COUNT(*) BY method = attributes.http.request.method
| SORT requests DESC
| LIMIT 10

FROM logs-supabase.otel-*
| WHERE attributes.supabase.service == "edge_logs" AND attributes.user_agent.original IS NOT NULL
| STATS `Requests` = COUNT(*) BY `User agent` = attributes.user_agent.original
| SORT `Requests` DESC
| LIMIT 10

FROM logs-supabase.otel-*
| WHERE attributes.supabase.service == "edge_logs" AND attributes.user_agent.original IS NOT NULL
| STATS `Requests` = COUNT(*) BY `User agent` = attributes.user_agent.original
| SORT `Requests` DESC
| LIMIT 10

FROM logs-supabase.otel-*
| WHERE attributes.supabase.service == "edge_logs" AND attributes.url.path IS NOT NULL
| EVAL is_client_error = CASE(attributes.http.response.status_code >= 400 AND attributes.http.response.status_code < 500, 1, 0), is_server_error = CASE(attributes.http.response.status_code >= 500, 1, 0)
| STATS `Requests` = COUNT(*), `Client errors` = SUM(is_client_error), `Server errors` = SUM(is_server_error) BY `Path` = attributes.url.path, `Method` = attributes.http.request.method
| SORT `Requests` DESC
| LIMIT 100

FROM logs-supabase.otel-*
| WHERE attributes.supabase.service == "edge_logs" AND attributes.url.path IS NOT NULL
| EVAL is_client_error = CASE(attributes.http.response.status_code >= 400 AND attributes.http.response.status_code < 500, 1, 0), is_server_error = CASE(attributes.http.response.status_code >= 500, 1, 0)
| STATS `Requests` = COUNT(*), `Client errors` = SUM(is_client_error), `Server errors` = SUM(is_server_error) BY `Path` = attributes.url.path, `Method` = attributes.http.request.method
| SORT `Requests` DESC
| LIMIT 100

params.markdown:
## 6 · Edge Functions — `edge_function_invocation_logs` + `edge_function_logs`

Two views of the same runtime. Invocation logs give one record per HTTP call with
execution time; runtime logs carry boot/shutdown lifecycle, `console.*` output and
uncaught exception stack traces. Correlate the two on the function ID.

query.esql:
FROM logs-supabase.otel-*
| WHERE attributes.supabase.service == "edge_function_invocation_logs"
| STATS invocations = COUNT(*) BY time_bucket = BUCKET(@timestamp, 20, ?_tstart, ?_tend), status = TO_STRING(attributes.http.response.status_code)
| SORT time_bucket ASC

FROM logs-supabase.otel-*
| WHERE attributes.supabase.service == "edge_function_invocation_logs"
| STATS invocations = COUNT(*) BY time_bucket = BUCKET(@timestamp, 20, ?_tstart, ?_tend), status = TO_STRING(attributes.http.response.status_code)
| SORT time_bucket ASC

FROM logs-supabase.otel-*
| WHERE attributes.supabase.service == "edge_function_invocation_logs" AND attributes.supabase.event.duration IS NOT NULL
| EVAL duration_ms = attributes.supabase.event.duration / 1000000
| STATS p50 = PERCENTILE(duration_ms, 50.0), p95 = PERCENTILE(duration_ms, 95.0), p99 = PERCENTILE(duration_ms, 99.0) BY time_bucket = BUCKET(@timestamp, 20, ?_tstart, ?_tend)
| SORT time_bucket ASC

FROM logs-supabase.otel-*
| WHERE attributes.supabase.service == "edge_function_invocation_logs" AND attributes.supabase.event.duration IS NOT NULL
| EVAL duration_ms = attributes.supabase.event.duration / 1000000
| STATS p50 = PERCENTILE(duration_ms, 50.0), p95 = PERCENTILE(duration_ms, 95.0), p99 = PERCENTILE(duration_ms, 99.0) BY time_bucket = BUCKET(@timestamp, 20, ?_tstart, ?_tend)
| SORT time_bucket ASC

FROM logs-supabase.otel-*
| WHERE attributes.supabase.service == "edge_function_invocation_logs"
| EVAL duration_ms = attributes.supabase.event.duration / 1000000, is_error = CASE(attributes.http.response.status_code >= 400, 1, 0)
| STATS `Invocations` = COUNT(*), `Errors` = SUM(is_error), `p95 ms` = PERCENTILE(duration_ms, 95.0) BY `Function` = attributes.supabase.function.id, `Deployment` = attributes.supabase.function.deployment_id
| SORT `Invocations` DESC
| LIMIT 50

FROM logs-supabase.otel-*
| WHERE attributes.supabase.service == "edge_function_invocation_logs"
| EVAL duration_ms = attributes.supabase.event.duration / 1000000, is_error = CASE(attributes.http.response.status_code >= 400, 1, 0)
| STATS `Invocations` = COUNT(*), `Errors` = SUM(is_error), `p95 ms` = PERCENTILE(duration_ms, 95.0) BY `Function` = attributes.supabase.function.id, `Deployment` = attributes.supabase.function.deployment_id
| SORT `Invocations` DESC
| LIMIT 50

FROM logs-supabase.otel-*
| WHERE attributes.supabase.service == "edge_function_logs"
| STATS records = COUNT(*) BY time_bucket = BUCKET(@timestamp, 20, ?_tstart, ?_tend), severity = TO_LOWER(severity_text)
| SORT time_bucket ASC

FROM logs-supabase.otel-*
| WHERE attributes.supabase.service == "edge_function_logs"
| STATS records = COUNT(*) BY time_bucket = BUCKET(@timestamp, 20, ?_tstart, ?_tend), severity = TO_LOWER(severity_text)
| SORT time_bucket ASC

FROM logs-supabase.otel-*
| WHERE attributes.supabase.service == "edge_function_logs"
| SORT @timestamp DESC

params.markdown:
## 7 · Storage — `storage_logs`

A **mixed-shape stream**: HTTP request logs interleaved with `[Lifecycle]` object
notifications that carry no HTTP fields. Request and latency panels filter on
`attributes.http.request.method IS NOT NULL` so lifecycle records do not inflate counts;
the lifecycle panel takes the complement. Paths here are service-relative (`/object/...`),
unlike the gateway-absolute paths in section 5.

query.esql:
FROM logs-supabase.otel-*
| WHERE attributes.supabase.service == "storage_logs" AND attributes.http.request.method IS NOT NULL
| STATS requests = COUNT(*) BY time_bucket = BUCKET(@timestamp, 20, ?_tstart, ?_tend), status = TO_STRING(attributes.http.response.status_code)
| SORT time_bucket ASC

FROM logs-supabase.otel-*
| WHERE attributes.supabase.service == "storage_logs" AND attributes.http.request.method IS NOT NULL
| STATS requests = COUNT(*) BY time_bucket = BUCKET(@timestamp, 20, ?_tstart, ?_tend), status = TO_STRING(attributes.http.response.status_code)
| SORT time_bucket ASC

FROM logs-supabase.otel-*
| WHERE attributes.supabase.service == "storage_logs" AND attributes.http.request.method IS NOT NULL AND attributes.supabase.event.duration IS NOT NULL
| EVAL duration_ms = attributes.supabase.event.duration / 1000000
| STATS p50 = PERCENTILE(duration_ms, 50.0), p95 = PERCENTILE(duration_ms, 95.0), p99 = PERCENTILE(duration_ms, 99.0) BY time_bucket = BUCKET(@timestamp, 20, ?_tstart, ?_tend)
| SORT time_bucket ASC

FROM logs-supabase.otel-*

| SORT time_bucket ASC

FROM logs-supabase.otel-*
| WHERE attributes.supabase.service == "storage_logs" AND attributes.http.request.method IS NOT NULL

params.markdown:
## 8 · Realtime — `realtime_logs`

Typically the highest-volume stream, dominated by periodic billing-metric emissions.
`attributes.supabase.realtime.limit` is **overloaded** — a connection cap on
`[:realtime, :connections]` records but a channel- or presence-event quota on rate-counter
records. The connection panels therefore filter on
`attributes.supabase.realtime.connected IS NOT NULL`; those records are a small minority
of the stream, so expect sparse series.

query.esql:
FROM logs-supabase.otel-*
| WHERE attributes.supabase.service == "realtime_logs"
| STATS records = COUNT(*) BY time_bucket = BUCKET(@timestamp, 20, ?_tstart, ?_tend), severity = TO_LOWER(severity_text)
| SORT time_bucket ASC

FROM logs-supabase.otel-*
| WHERE attributes.supabase.service == "realtime_logs"
| STATS records = COUNT(*) BY time_bucket = BUCKET(@timestamp, 20, ?_tstart, ?_tend), severity = TO_LOWER(severity_text)
| SORT time_bucket ASC

FROM logs-supabase.otel-*
| WHERE attributes.supabase.service == "realtime_logs" AND attributes.supabase.realtime.connected IS NOT NULL
| STATS node_connections = MAX(attributes.supabase.realtime.connected), cluster_connections = MAX(attributes.supabase.realtime.connected_cluster), connection_limit = MAX(attributes.supabase.realtime.limit) BY time_bucket = BUCKET(@timestamp, 20, ?_tstart, ?_tend)
| SORT time_bucket ASC

FROM logs-supabase.otel-*
| WHERE attributes.supabase.service == "realtime_logs" AND attributes.supabase.realtime.connected IS NOT NULL
| STATS node_connections = MAX(attributes.supabase.realtime.connected), cluster_connections = MAX(attributes.supabase.realtime.connected_cluster), connection_limit = MAX(attributes.supabase.realtime.limit) BY time_bucket = BUCKET(@timestamp, 20, ?_tstart, ?_tend)
| SORT time_bucket ASC

FROM logs-supabase.otel-*
| WHERE attributes.supabase.service == "realtime_logs" AND attributes.supabase.realtime.connected IS NOT NULL AND attributes.supabase.realtime.limit > 0
| EVAL utilisation = TO_DOUBLE(attributes.supabase.realtime.connected_cluster) / TO_DOUBLE(attributes.supabase.realtime.limit)
| STATS peak_utilisation = MAX(utilisation)
| EVAL gauge_min = 0.0, gauge_max = 1.0

FROM logs-supabase.otel-*
| WHERE attributes.supabase.service == "realtime_logs" AND attributes.supabase.realtime.connected IS NOT NULL AND attributes.supabase.realtime.limit > 0
| EVAL utilisation = TO_DOUBLE(attributes.supabase.realtime.connected_cluster) / TO_DOUBLE(attributes.supabase.realtime.limit)
| STATS peak_utilisation = MAX(utilisation)
| EVAL gauge_min = 0.0, gauge_max = 1.0

FROM logs-supabase.otel-*
| WHERE attributes.supabase.service == "realtime_logs" AND body.text LIKE "Billing metrics:*"
| EVAL metric = CASE(attributes.supabase.realtime.connected IS NOT NULL, "Connections", body.text LIKE "*presence_events]*", "Presence events", body.text LIKE "*:events]*", "Channel events", "Other")
| STATS records = COUNT(*) BY metric
| SORT records DESC
| LIMIT 10

| STATS records = COUNT(*) BY metric
| SORT records DESC
| LIMIT 10
